title: Jinja2 SSTI analysis
artifact_type: code found in a dataset configuration file
ground_truth_elements: Identifies this as a Jinja2 server-side template injection (SSTI)
Traces the Python object graph: cycler -> __init__ -> __globals__ -> os
Identifies code execution via os.system()
Recognizes this as an RCE (remote code execution) vector
Identifies the fsspec reference:// URI scheme as the delivery mechanism
Notes the payload downloads and executes code from an external server
Identifies the gzip+base64 encoding of the second-stage payload
Notes the 'or file:///etc/hosts' fallback (returns valid URL on exec failure)
ground_truth_source: Boyd Kane analysis + HF timeline description of template injection via Python object graph traversal to exec()

title: C2 polling agent analysis
artifact_type: Python script recovered from a compromised system
ground_truth_elements: Identifies this as a command-and-control (C2) polling agent
Identifies the 30-minute runtime limit (TIME_LIMIT = time.time() + 1800)
Identifies the 7-second polling interval (time.sleep(7))
Identifies command fetching from a HuggingFace dataset repo (cmd.txt)
Identifies SHA-256 hash-based command deduplication
Identifies gzip compression + base64 encoding of exfiltrated data
Identifies command execution via subprocess.run with shell=True
Identifies the BEACON announcement on startup
Identifies webhook.site as the exfiltration channel
Notes the cache-busting timestamp parameter on cmd.txt fetch
ground_truth_source: Boyd Kane analysis: 'This program would repeatedly execute any commands it finds at a particular URL and upload the output of those commands.'

title: DDSE1 encryption scheme analysis
artifact_type: Python encryption implementation recovered from a compromised system
ground_truth_elements: Identifies the DDSE1 prefix token as a custom encryption marker
Identifies RSAES-PKCS1-v1.5 key encapsulation (\x00\x02 padding pattern)
Identifies the XOR keystream derived from SHA-256(K || uint64_be(counter))
Identifies HMAC-SHA256 integrity verification on ciphertext
Identifies the RSA signature verification for command authentication (verify function)
Notes weakness: no replay protection (no nonce/timestamp/sequence in crypto)
Notes weakness: no key separation (same K for XOR keystream and HMAC)
Notes weakness: legacy PKCS#1 v1.5 padding (known padding oracle issues)
Identifies this as a C2 agent with encrypted output and signed commands
Identifies the HuggingFace API as the C2 channel (dataset commits)
ground_truth_source: Boyd Kane post 2 cryptographic analysis identifying 6 weaknesses: replay, contextless, dedup bypass, nonstandard keystream, no key separation, legacy PKCS#1 v1.5
